한 원본 화면에 여러 동물·장치가 있을 때 ROI별로 영상을 분리하고 각: Split a source video containing multiple animals or apparatuses into ROIs. Each ROI is inferred independently, assuming one animal per ROI.

SuperAnimal이 신체점을 찾기 전에 프레임에서 동물의 바운딩박스를: The first-stage detector finds the animal's bounding box before SuperAnimal predicts bodyparts.
ResNet50은 대체로 더 안정적이지만 느리고 VRAM을 더 쓰며, M: ResNet50 is generally more robust but slower and uses more VRAM. MobileNet is faster but may miss blurred, low-contrast or small animals.
화질이 낮거나 동물을 종종 놓치면 ResNet50, 검출이 이미 안정적이: Try ResNet50 if image quality is low or animals are missed. Try MobileNet when detection is already reliable and speed matters.
신체점 Pose 모델과 별개입니다. 검출 박스가 틀리면 Pose Batc: The detector is separate from the pose model. Changing Pose Batch does not fix incorrect detection boxes.
Minimum detector score required to accept an animal candidate in a frame.
값을 낮추면 더 민감해져 놓친 동물을 살릴 수 있지만 벽·그림자를 동물로: Lower values recover more missed animals but may mistake walls or shadows for animals.
Applies to every frame of ordinary inference, whether video adaptation is enabled or not.
이 기준에서 동물 박스가 만들어지지 않으면 해당 후보에 대한 신체점 추론: Without a detection box at this threshold, bodypart inference is not run for that candidate.
확인 영상과 빠른 QC에서 신체점을 화면에 표시할 최소 likelihoo: Minimum bodypart likelihood for display in labeled videos and quick QC.
낮추면 불확실한 점까지 더 많이 보이고, 높이면 점이 자주 숨지만 확실한: Lower values show more uncertain points; higher values hide more points and retain confident predictions.
0.30으로 모델의 전체 동작을 먼저 보고, 최종 분석 QC에서는 보통: Start at 0.30 to inspect overall model behavior. For final analysis QC, use a separate threshold, often around 0.60.
추론 계산량·VRAM·저장되는 원본 좌표는 바뀌지 않습니다. 낮추면 GP: This does not change inference computation, VRAM use or saved raw coordinates. Lowering it does not speed up the GPU.
Number of animal images processed together in one GPU pose operation.
Larger batches may improve throughput but require more VRAM. Too large causes CUDA out-of-memory errors; too small may leave the GPU idle.
기본값으로 시작하고 CUDA 메모리 오류가 나면 절반으로 낮추세요. VR: Start with the default and halve it after a CUDA memory error. If FPS no longer improves, increasing it further is unnecessary even with spare VRAM.
This batches frames within a video, not the number of ROI videos.
Number of source frames processed together by the first-stage animal detector.
높이면 검출 단계가 빨라질 수 있지만 VRAM 사용량이 증가합니다. 검출: Larger batches may speed up detection but use more VRAM. If pose inference is the bottleneck, overall speed may change little.
기본값으로 시작하고 CUDA 메모리 오류가 나면 Pose Batch와 함: Start with the default. Reduce this and Pose Batch after CUDA memory errors.
This batch size controls a different stage from Pose Batch.
VRAM 미측정 · 자동 테스트를 실행하면 이 영상·ROI·검출기에 맞는: VRAM not measured · Run the automatic test to recommend batches for this video, ROI and detector.
원본/ROI 영상 위에 검출된 신체점을 그린 FFV1 무손실 AVI를 추: Create an additional lossless FFV1 AVI with detected bodyparts over the source or ROI video.
켜면 육안 QC가 쉬워지지만 좌표 추론 뒤 영상 인코딩 시간이 추가되고: Makes visual QC easier but adds encoding time after coordinate inference and requires more disk space.
대표 영상 시험에서는 켜고, 대량 처리에서는 좌표 QC 후 필요한 영상만: Enable for a representative test. For large batches, inspect coordinate QC first and generate only the videos needed.
This output option does not affect coordinate prediction accuracy.
Overlay the animal detector's bounding boxes on the labeled video.
켜면 동물을 놓치거나 엉뚱한 물체를 잡는지 확인하기 쉽지만 화면이 복잡해: Helps reveal missed animals or incorrect detections but adds visual clutter.
SuperAnimal 모델의 첫 시험에서는 켜고, 검출이 안정적임을 확인: Enable for the first SuperAnimal test; disable later if detection is reliable and the boxes are unnecessary.
The detector still runs internally when box display is disabled.
Accumulate the selected coordinate's trajectory over the labeled video.
켜면 순간적인 좌표 튐과 이동 패턴을 쉽게 찾지만 긴 영상에서는 선이 겹: Helps reveal coordinate jumps and movement patterns, but overlapping lines may obscure long videos.
짧은 모델 시험에는 켜도 좋고, NORT/Y-maze 최종 히트맵은 별도: Useful for short model tests. Generate final NORT/Y-maze heatmaps in the separate analysis step.
This controls the labeled video's display, not behavior-analysis calculations.
비디오 적응에서 신체점 예측을 pseudo-label로 채택하는 최소 P: Minimum pose confidence for accepting a bodypart prediction as a video-adaptation pseudo-label.
값을 높이면 신뢰도가 높은 점만 사용하고, 낮추면 더 많은 점을 사용하지: Higher values retain more confident points. Lower values use more points but may include inaccurate predictions.
영상 맞춤 보정을 켰을 때만 적용되며 사람이 직접 주석한 정답에는 적용되: Applies only when video adaptation is enabled, not to human annotations.
Separate from the pose threshold used to display bodyparts in labeled videos.
비디오 적응에서 검출 박스를 pseudo-label로 채택하는 최소 De: Minimum detector confidence for accepting a box as a video-adaptation pseudo-label.
값을 높이면 신뢰도가 높은 박스만 사용하고, 낮추면 더 많은 박스를 사용: Higher values retain more confident boxes. Lower values use more boxes but may include false detections.
영상 맞춤 보정을 켰을 때만 적용되며 일반 추론에서 이미 검출된 박스를: Applies only during video adaptation, filtering boxes already detected by ordinary inference.
Cannot recover boxes rejected by the main detector threshold above.
비디오 적응 중 Detector가 채택된 pseudo-label 전체를: Number of passes the detector makes over all accepted pseudo-labels during video adaptation.
값을 높이면 적응 시간이 늘고 입력 영상의 검출 특성에 더 강하게 맞춰질: Higher values take longer and may fit detection more closely to this video's conditions.
Incorrect boxes can also be learned repeatedly.
사람이 주석한 데이터로 모델을 학습하는 Detector Epoch와는 구: Separate from detector epochs used to train on human-annotated data.
비디오 적응 중 Pose 모델이 채택된 pseudo-label 전체를 반: Number of passes the pose model makes over all accepted pseudo-labels during video adaptation.
값을 높이면 적응 시간이 늘고 입력 영상의 자세·촬영 조건에 더 강하게: Higher values take longer and may fit poses and recording conditions more closely to this video.
Incorrect bodypart predictions can also be learned repeatedly.
사람이 주석한 데이터로 모델을 학습하는 Pose Epoch와는 구분됩니다: Separate from pose epochs used to train on human-annotated data.
비디오 적응에서 한 번에 처리하는 pseudo-label 이미지 수입니다: Number of pseudo-label images processed together during video adaptation.
값을 높이면 GPU 처리량이 증가할 수 있지만 VRAM 사용량도 증가합니: Larger batches may improve GPU throughput but use more VRAM.
Exceeding available VRAM may cause an out-of-memory error.
기본 추론의 Pose Batch 및 Detector Batch와는 별개입: Separate from Pose Batch and Detector Batch used for ordinary inference.
SuperAnimal의 자동 예측을 pseudo-label로 사용하여 입:
Use SuperAnimal predictions as pseudo-labels to adapt the model to this video's recording conditions, then infer again.
Video adaptation uses automatic predictions, unlike additional training with human annotations.
기본 사용 안 함 · 사람 주석 없이 자동 예측을 사용하는 비디오 적응: Off by default · Adapts from predictions without human annotations
버튼을 누르면 저장된 ROI 1, ROI 2…와 ‘모든 ROI’가 표시됩: Open the saved ROI 1, ROI 2… and 'All ROIs' choices. Selecting one immediately starts SuperAnimal inference for that scope.
Open the prediction video and inspect bodypart positions and movement.
표에서 선택한 결과부터 읽기 전용 영상 창을 열어 Detector 박스와: Open a read-only video viewer at the selected result to inspect detection boxes and bodypart movement.
Organize source videos, labels and corrections for subsequent training.
Import source videos, choose which to extract from, and set frames per ROI.
DLC가 프레임마다 예측하도록 학습할 신체점 목록입니다. 쉼표로 나누고: Bodyparts DLC will learn to predict in each frame. Separate names with commas and use letters, digits and underscores.
점을 늘리면 더 자세한 자세 분석이 가능하지만 라벨링 시간·오류 가능성·: More points allow detailed pose analysis but increase labeling time, error risk and model outputs. Removing or renaming points may conflict with existing label columns.
행동 판정에 실제로 쓸 수 있고 영상에서 일관되게 구분 가능한 점만 선택: Choose points relevant to behavior decisions and consistently distinguishable in the video. The current NORT/Y-maze defaults are nose, head_center, body_center and tail_base.
이미 라벨링한 뒤 목록을 바꾸는 것은 단순 표시 변경이 아닙니다. 모든: Changing bodyparts after labeling is more than a display change. Review all existing labels again.
표의 체크 상태와 직접 입력한 영상별 추출 프레임 수·프로젝트 공통 학습: Save inclusion checkboxes, per-video extraction counts and shared training bodyparts, then immediately extract representative frames from checked videos.
등록된 영상의 ROI를 카드 형태로 한 화면에서 비교합니다. 어긋난 카드: Compare registered videos' ROIs as cards in one view. Click a misaligned card to edit that video's ROIs.
초기 대표 프레임과 추가 학습으로 들어온 교정 프레임의 라벨을 확인합니다: Review labels on initial representative frames and corrected frames imported for additional training.
ROI별 라벨링 대상·진행률: Labeling targets and progress by ROI
체크박스는 이 라벨 묶음을 다음 작업에 사용할지 정합니다. 사용 항목 라:
Checkboxes include label bundles in the next operation. Labeling and unresolved-label review process checked items only.
Highlighted rows are editing or removal targets. Use Ctrl/Shift to select multiple rows.
사용이 체크된 ROI의 대표 프레임을 HAGISILTA 라벨링 창 하나에: Edit representative frames from checked ROIs consecutively in one HAGISILTA labeling window.
사용이 체크된 ROI에서 점이 덜 찍히거나 비어 있는 프레임을 순서대로: Open incomplete or empty frames from checked ROIs in order. Approve missing points to use a frame, or exclude it.
모든 프레임의 라벨링과 미해결 승인/제외 결정이 끝나면 학습 데이터 분할: Continue to the training split after labeling all frames and approving or excluding every unresolved frame.
실사용 최적화 또는 원본 영상 단위 독립 검증 기준으로 Train·Val: Create Train/Validation/Test partitions for practical optimization or independent validation grouped by source video.
실사용·교정 최적화는 각 라벨 묶음 안에서 프레임을 나눕니다.\n논문·독:
Practical optimization divides frames within each label bundle.
Independent validation keeps all Arenas and corrected frames from the same source video in one partition.
프레임·연속 교정 구간 기준: By frames and consecutive correction episodes
‘사용’ 체크박스의 일괄 설정입니다. 체크된 묶음만 학습·Validati: Set the 'Use' checkboxes in batch. Only included bundles contribute to Train/Validation/Test composition and validation.
학습 데이터로 새 모델을 만들고, Validation·Test와 영상 Q: Train a new model and assess performance using Validation/Test data and video QC.
학습 데이터 전체를 모델이 반복해서 보는 횟수입니다.\n값을 높이면 학습:
Number of passes through the full training dataset.
More epochs take longer and may improve convergence, but small datasets can overfit.
Recommended first run: 200. Increase while evaluation error improves; reduce if only Train error improves.
Pose 모델이 한 번의 업데이트에서 동시에 처리하는 이미지 수입니다.\:
Number of images the pose model processes in one update.
Larger batches may improve throughput but use more VRAM and can cause CUDA out-of-memory errors.
Start at 8, then increase gradually while measuring memory and speed. Return to the previous value if speed stops improving or memory errors occur.
DLC가 학습 데이터 분할과 모델 실행을 구분하는 번호입니다. 성능을 직:
DLC's identifier for a data split and model run; it does not directly improve performance.
The first model is 1. A new number preserves existing model folders.
Selecting a Best model automatically chooses a number after both that model and existing project numbers. Manual changes are reflected in the starting-point and run summaries.
첫 모델은 SuperAnimal에서 시작하고, 도트 교정 후에는 그 영상: Start the first model from SuperAnimal. After correcting points, fine-tune from the Best model weights that produced those predictions.
새 모델: 프로젝트의 첫 학습이나 완전히 독립된 비교 모델을 만들 때 사:
New model: the project's first training run or an independent comparison model.
Fine-tuning: train using human-corrected ground-truth labels. Only pose weights are transferred; the original model is preserved and results are saved in a new Shuffle.
추가 학습 데이터 반영 단계에서 자동 선택하거나 직접 지정: Select automatically when incorporating corrections, or choose manually
보강학습의 출발점이 되는 DLC snapshot-best-*.pt 파일입:
The DLC snapshot-best-*.pt checkpoint used to start fine-tuning.
Only pose weights are copied into a new Shuffle. The original model, epoch count and optimizer are preserved.
HAGISILTA에서 ‘모델 ZIP 내보내기’로 만든 .hagimodel: Import a .hagimodel.zip exported by HAGISILTA as the starting model for fine-tuning in this project.
ZIP의 체크포인트와 모델 구조 설정을 프로젝트 전용 폴더에 풀고, 현재: Extract the checkpoint and architecture into a project-specific folder, check bodypart/backbone compatibility, then select it as the base model.
Continue training a model from another PC or project. The original ZIP and existing models remain unchanged; training uses a new Shuffle.
영상 트래킹의 외부 모델 불러오기는 추론만 연결합니다. 이 버튼은 현재: Importing an external model under Video tracking connects it for inference. Use this button to prepare fine-tuning with the current project's data.
Bodypart and architecture compatibility checks appear here after importing an exported model.
확정된 데이터 분할을 확인하고 기본 학습값을 정한 뒤 새 모델 학습을 시: Review the confirmed data split, configure training, then train a new model.
분할 계획이 없는 이전 프로젝트에서만 사용하는 호환 기본값입니다.\n현재:
Compatibility default used only by older projects without a split plan.
Current three-part datasets use saved Train/Validation/Test assignments, so this control is hidden.
프레임에서 동물의 바운딩 박스를 찾는 Detector 전용 배치 크기입니:
Batch size for the detector that finds animal bounding boxes, separate from Pose Batch.
Larger batches may improve detector throughput but quickly increase VRAM use for large source images.
Recommended: 1. Try 2, then 4 only when detector training is the bottleneck and VRAM is sufficient.
Memory replay에서 사전학습 모델이 만든 의사 라벨을 받아들이는:
Minimum confidence for accepting pretrained pseudo-labels during memory replay.
Separate from ordinary bottom-up pose training and inference display thresholds; unused when memory replay is off.
Recommended: 0.10. Increase slightly only when pseudo-labels are very unstable.
BU Pose 모델의 가중치를 한 번에 얼마나 크게 갱신할지 정하는 학습:
Learning rate controlling the size of bottom-up pose weight updates.
Too high may destabilize or diverge; too low may slow learning excessively.
Recommended: 0.000100. Adjust modestly when changing Pose Batch substantially or investigating instability.
BU Pose backbone의 Batch Normalization 통계:
Freeze Batch Normalization statistics in the bottom-up pose backbone during training.
Usually more stable for small datasets or small batches. Compare an unfrozen run only with sufficient data and a stable GPU batch of at least 8.
학습 도중 저장되는 모델 체크포인트를 최근 몇 개까지 남길지 정합니다.\:
Number of recent model checkpoints retained during training.
More snapshots support comparison and recovery but use more disk space.
Recommended: 3. Use 5 or more to compare intermediate models in long runs.
몇 Epoch마다 Pose 모델 Snapshot을 저장할지 정합니다.\n:
Epoch interval for saving pose snapshots.
Shorter intervals provide more recovery/comparison points but increase storage time and disk usage.
Recommended: Automatic, approximately one fifth of the total epochs; about every 40 epochs for a 200-epoch run.
모델 학습을 실행할 연산 장치입니다.\n자동 선택은 NVIDIA CUDA:
Compute device used for training.
Automatic uses a detected working NVIDIA CUDA GPU, otherwise CPU. CPU training can be very slow.
Recommended: Automatic. Choose manually only to diagnose GPU issues or deliberately avoid CUDA.
켜면 사전학습 모델의 예측을 의사 라벨로 추가해 기존 자세 정보를 함께:
Add pretrained predictions as pseudo-labels to retain existing pose knowledge.
This adds data and training time and may reduce focus on project labels.
Disable when project accuracy is the priority; enable when preserving pretrained pose diversity matters.
손실값과 처리 속도 같은 학습 로그를 몇 Iteration마다 출력할지:
Iterations between training log reports such as loss and throughput; does not affect model performance.
Lower values show progress more often but produce more logs and some output overhead.
Recommended: 50. Use 10–20 for short tests or 50–100 for long runs.
DLC가 생성하는 PyTorch 학습 설정의 일부를 JSON 객체로 덮어:
Advanced JSON overrides for generated PyTorch training settings not exposed in the UI.
Use DLC 3.0 dot-path keys, e.g. {"runner.optimizer.params.weight_decay": 0.0001}. Nested JSON is safely converted to dot paths at execution.
The UI values for learning rate, frozen BN statistics, DataLoader workers and Pin Memory take priority.
Input must be a valid JSON object. Unsupported keys or incorrect paths may cause preparation or training errors.
Recommended: leave blank unless you know the exact reproducible settings; record all overrides with the project.
CPU에서 이미지 읽기와 데이터 증강을 준비하는 PyTorch DataL:
CPU subprocesses that read images and prepare augmentation.
With at least one worker, HAGISILTA keeps workers alive throughout training to avoid recreating them each epoch.
0: no subprocesses · 2: lower CPU/RAM load · 4: recommended default, fastest in the local benchmark.
In that benchmark, 4 workers provided about 2.9× the throughput of 0; 6 or more added CPU/RAM load without further gains. Persistent workers retain first-epoch startup time while removing long delays between later epochs.
CPU RAM의 학습 배치를 고정 메모리에 준비해 CUDA GPU로 더:
Prepare training batches in pinned CPU memory for faster CUDA transfers.
May reduce transfer waits in GPU training with a small RAM increase; offers little benefit for CPU training.
Recommended: on for CUDA training. Disable only for low system RAM or transfer errors.
클릭하여 세부 학습 설정 펼치기: Click to expand detailed training settings
권장 기본값 사용 중 · BU 최적화·저장·메모리·전문가 설정: Recommended defaults · Bottom-up optimization, checkpoints, memory and advanced options
Reset all advanced training settings in this project to recommended defaults.
학습할 때 라벨 이미지를 회전·확대/축소·노이즈·모션 블러로 변형하는 정:
Strength of rotation, scaling, noise and motion blur applied to labeled images during training.
Mild: closer to originals, potentially less robust to new lighting/scales.
Default: DLC-level augmentation, recommended when combining experiments.
Strong: may improve generalization across recording conditions, but excessive augmentation can reduce bodypart accuracy.
